syllabus_tests.name: Python Basics Syllabus
syllabus_tests.input_text:
Introduction to Python Programming

Python is a high-level programming language. Key topics include:
1. Variables and Data Types (integers, strings, lists)
2. Control Flow (if statements, loops)
3. Functions and Modules
4. Object-Oriented Programming (classes, inheritance)
5. File I/O and Exception Handling

syllabus_tests.name: Machine Learning Syllabus
syllabus_tests.input_text:
Machine Learning Fundamentals

Core concepts:
1. Supervised Learning (regression, classification)
2. Unsupervised Learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction)
3. Neural Networks and Deep Learning
4. Model Evaluation (accuracy, precision, recall)
5. Feature Engineering and Data Preprocessing

syllabus_tests.name: Web Development Syllabus
syllabus_tests.input_text:
Full Stack Web Development

Topics covered:
1. HTML and CSS Fundamentals
2. JavaScript and DOM Manipulation
3. Backend Development with Node.js
4. Database Design (SQL and NoSQL)
5. RESTful APIs and Authentication

syllabus_tests.name: Data Structures Syllabus
syllabus_tests.input_text:
Data Structures and Algorithms

Key topics:
1. Arrays and Linked Lists
2. Stacks and Queues
3. Trees and Graphs
4. Sorting Algorithms (quicksort, mergesort)
5. Hash Tables and Search Algorithms

syllabus_tests.name: DevOps Syllabus
syllabus_tests.input_text:
DevOps Engineering Practices

Core areas:
1. Version Control with Git
2. Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD)
3. Containerization with Docker
4. Orchestration with Kubernetes
5. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible)

concept_tests.name: Python Variables Concept
concept_tests.input_text:
Python Variables

Variables in Python are used to store data. Python is dynamically typed, meaning you don't need to declare variable types. Example: x = 5 creates an integer variable.

concept_tests.name: HTTP Methods Concept
concept_tests.input_text:
HTTP Request Methods

HTTP defines methods like GET (retrieve data), POST (submit data), PUT (update data), and DELETE (remove data). These are the foundation of RESTful APIs.

concept_tests.name: Binary Search Concept
concept_tests.input_text:
Binary Search Algorithm

Binary search is an efficient algorithm for finding an item in a sorted array. It works by repeatedly dividing the search interval in half. Time complexity is O(log n).

concept_tests.name: Docker Containers Concept
concept_tests.input_text:
Docker Containers

Docker containers package applications with their dependencies into isolated units. Containers are lightweight, portable, and share the host OS kernel.

concept_tests.name: SQL Joins Concept
concept_tests.input_text:
SQL JOIN Operations

JOINs combine rows from two or more tables based on related columns. Types include INNER JOIN (matching rows), LEFT JOIN (all left rows), and RIGHT JOIN (all right rows).
